verdict.rationale: Teller is a bank-data and payments API. The evidence documents account, transaction, identity and payment endpoints, dashboard-configured webhooks, and a sandbox. Nothing shows a user-authored automation feature, let alone versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Webhooks and idempotent payment requests are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
